decisions.reason: The source explicitly applies the reference-color choice only to the Weave Print; the Zebra palette remains governed by its separate caramel/bronze and reduced-tone directions.
The Weave-specific color change does not alter the Terracotta pareo's independently specified interior color or border.
Choosing the original reference color for the Weave does not change the existing color-management workflow, output mode, Pantone handling, fabric options, or ICC-profile handling.
The source decision concerns only the Weave Print palette and does not modify the Mustard block-color pareo.
The Weave palette revision does not change the requirement to deliver final production-ready artwork files.
